entries.task_id: saa mpaemuka|yi|bere nyinaa
entries.description: saa Mpaemuka yi bere nyinaa
entries.subject: saa Mpaemuka
entries.object: bere nyinaa

spans.text: Sɛ mmɔdenbɔ gyinapɛn ma nkurɔfɔ ne aman nyinaa, a yɛn botae ne sɛ nnipa nkorɛnkorɛ ne aman nyinaa bɛkae saa Mpaemuka yi bere nyinaa, na wɔnam ɔkyerɛkyerɛ ne nhomasua so akyerɛ obu ama saa kyɛfa ne ahofadi ahorow yi, na wɔde nkakrankakra ama nnipa a wɔwɔ wɔn a wɔwɔ amannɔne ate ase, agye atom, adi so pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ nnipa a wɔwɔ Kuw Mma no ankasa man mu, ne ɔmanfo a wɔtete wɔn nsasesin mu.

entries.description: wɔ Mpaemuka yi mu no a nnipa animhwɛ anaa nyiyim nni mu
entries.subject: wɔ Mpaemuka
entries.object: mu no a nnipa animhwɛ anaa nyiyim nni mu

spans.text: Ɛsɛ sɛ obiara nya kyɛfa ne ahofadi ahorow a wɔaka ho asɛm wɔ Mpaemuka yi mu no a nnipa animhwɛ anaa nyiyim nni mu, te sɛ ebia abusua a ofi mu, ahosu, sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbea anaa ɔbarima, sɛ ɔka kasa bi anaa ɔwɔ kuw bi mu, sɛ ɔwɔ ahode, sɛ wɔwoo no ɔkwan bi so no mfa ho koraa.

spans.text: Saa Kyɛfa anaa hokwan yi yera bere a guankɔ no nnyina amanyɛsɛm mu amanenya anaa Amanaman Nkabom gyinae so.

Saa kyɛfa anaa hokwan yi ma obi de ne ho sɛ ɔbɛsakra ne nyamesom anaa ne gyidi, ɛma obiara de ne ho sɛ ɔhwehwɛ ankorankoro anaa ɔdodow nyamesom, anaa ɔne afoforo bom som wɔ peteem anaa kokoam, nam so yi ne nyamesom anaa gyidi adi wɔ kyerɛkyɛrɛ, nneyɛe ne ɔsom mu.

spans.text: Esiane sɛ Kuw Mma ahyɛ bɔ sɛ wɔne Amanaman Nkabom mo bɛyɛ biako de ama aman nyinaa anya obu ama onipa biara kyɛfa ne ahofadi ahorow no

folded.id: mmara no|mu|no agye sɛ wogye onipa biara kyɛfa tom
folded.subject: Mmara no
folded.object: no agye sɛ wogye onipa biara kyɛfa tom

spans.text: Esiane sɛ nnipa a wɔwɔ Amanaman Nkabom no Mmara no mu no agye sɛ wogye onipa biara kyɛfa tom, na wogye tom sɛ onipa desani biara nya ne kyɛfa, nidi ne ɔsom a wɔsom bo; afei wogye mmarima ne mmea Kyɛfa tom, na wɔbɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛma ɔmanfo atu mpɔn wɔ asetena pa mu wɔ ahofadi bebree mu,

folded.id: mmara|mu|no
folded.subject: Mmara
folded.object: no

spans.text: Mmara mu no, onipa biara wɔ ho kwan sɛ wogye no tom sɛ onipa.

folded.id: na akyiri|yi|wohu sɛ anka ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtwe n'aso
folded.subject: na akyiri
folded.object: wohu sɛ anka ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtwe n'aso

spans.text: Sɛ obi yɛ bɔne bi na akyiri yi wohu sɛ anka ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtwe n'aso, nanso bere a onii yo yɛɛ saa bɔne no, na ne man anaa ne man ne aman foforo bi mmɔɔ mu nyɛɛ mmara bi a etia bɔne no a, ɛnde ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔtwe ɔdebɔneyɛfo no aso.

folded.id: na odi|mu|fɔ ma wɔtwe n'aso no wɔremfa nto onipa biara so gye sɛ wɔnam mmara so adi onii no asɛm wɔ n'akyigyinafo anim abu no fɔ ansa
folded.subject: na odi
folded.object: fɔ ma wɔtwe n'aso no wɔremfa nto onipa biara so gye sɛ wɔnam mmara so adi onii no asɛm wɔ n'akyigyinafo anim abu no fɔ ansa

spans.text: Asɛm a obi di na odi mu fɔ ma wɔtwe n'aso no wɔremfa nto onipa biara so gye sɛ wɔnam mmara so adi onii no asɛm wɔ n'akyigyinafo anim abu no fɔ ansa.

folded.id: nam so|yi|ne nyamesom anaa gyidi adi wɔ kyerɛkyɛrɛ
folded.subject: nam so
folded.object: ne nyamesom anaa gyidi adi wɔ kyerɛkyɛrɛ

spans.text: Saa kyɛfa anaa hokwan yi ma obi de ne ho sɛ ɔbɛsakra ne nyamesom anaa ne gyidi, ɛma obiara de ne ho sɛ ɔhwehwɛ ankorankoro anaa ɔdodow nyamesom, anaa ɔne afoforo bom som wɔ peteem anaa kokoam, nam so yi ne nyamesom anaa gyidi adi wɔ kyerɛkyɛrɛ, nneyɛe ne ɔsom mu.

folded.id: ne adwuma|mu|akwamma bere a wot
folded.subject: ne adwuma
folded.object: akwamma bere a wot

spans.text: Nnɔnhwerew a wɔahyehyɛ sɛ wɔde yɛ adwuma a ɛmmoro so ne adwuma mu akwamma bere a wot

folded.id: ne man|mu|aban mu
folded.subject: ne man
folded.object: Aban mu

spans.text: Obiara wɔ hokwan sɛ onya kyɛfa wɔ ne man mu Aban mu, sɛ ɛyɛ tee anaa ɛnam ananmusifo so.

folded.id: ne man|mu|bio
folded.subject: ne man
folded.object: bio

spans.text: Obiara wɔ ne kyɛfa anaa hokwan sɛ ofi ɔman biara mu, a n'ankasa de ka ho, na ɔsan kɔ ne man mu bio.

folded.id: ne man|mu|ɔkwa are kwa
folded.subject: ne man
folded.object: ɔkwa are kwa

spans.text: Wɔrenkyere obi, mfa no nto afiase anaa wɔrempam no mfi ne man mu ɔkwa are kwa.

folded.id: ɔwɔ adwumayɛ|mu|nhyehyɛe pa ne emu banbɔ no ho kyɛfa
folded.subject: ɔwɔ adwumayɛ
folded.object: nhyehyɛe pa ne emu banbɔ no ho kyɛfa

spans.text: Obiara wɔ adwumayɛ ho kyɛfa, ɔde ne ho sɛ ɔpaw adwuma a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ, ɔwɔ adwumayɛ mu nhyehyɛe pa ne emu banbɔ no ho kyɛfa.

folded.id: pae|mu|ka
folded.subject: Pae
folded.object: ka

spans.text: Pae mu ka

folded.id: remfa atuatew|kwan|so sɛ nea etwa to de atu atirimɔden ne nhyɛso agu
folded.subject: remfa atuatew
folded.object: so sɛ nea etwa to de atu atirimɔden ne nhyɛso agu

spans.text: Esiane sɛ nea ɛbɛyɛ na ɔmanfo remfa atuatew kwan so sɛ nea etwa to de atu atirimɔden ne nhyɛso agu, nti, ɛsɛ sɛ yɛde mmara sodi bɔ onipa biara kyɛfa ho ban,

folded.id: saa abusuakuw|yi|ho ban
folded.subject: saa abusuakuw
folded.object: ho ban

spans.text: Okunu ne ɔyere ne mma abusuabɔ no ne kuwyɛ abɔse fekuw biara mu, ɛsɛ sɛ fekuw anaa ɔman no bɔ saa abusuakuw yi ho ban.

folded.id: saa kyɛfa|yi|ma obiara kura ne nsusuwii mu a obiara nnye no asabawmu
folded.subject: Saa kyɛfa
folded.object: ma obiara kura ne nsusuwii mu a obiara nnye no asabawmu

spans.text: Saa kyɛfa yi ma obiara kura ne nsusuwii mu a obiara nnye no asabawmu.

folded.id: saa mpaemuka|yi|bere nyinaa
folded.subject: saa Mpaemuka
folded.object: bere nyinaa

spans.text: Sɛ mmɔdenbɔ gyinapɛn ma nkurɔfɔ ne aman nyinaa, a yɛn botae ne sɛ nnipa nkorɛnkorɛ ne aman nyinaa bɛkae saa Mpaemuka yi bere nyinaa, na wɔnam ɔkyerɛkyerɛ ne nhomasua so akyerɛ obu ama saa kyɛfa ne ahofadi ahorow yi, na wɔde nkakrankakra ama nnipa a wɔwɔ wɔn a wɔwɔ amannɔne ate ase, agye atom, adi so pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ nnipa a wɔwɔ Kuw Mma no ankasa man mu, ne ɔmanfo a wɔtete wɔn nsasesin mu.

folded.id: wɔ aware|mu|kyɛfa pɛ wɔ wɔn aware ne wɔn awaregu berem
folded.subject: wɔ aware
folded.object: kyɛfa pɛ wɔ wɔn aware ne wɔn awaregu berem

spans.text: Wɔn nyinaa wɔ aware mu kyɛfa pɛ wɔ wɔn aware ne wɔn awaregu berem.

folded.id: wɔ banbɔde|yi|kyɛfa a mmara taa akyi
folded.subject: wɔ banbɔde
folded.object: kyɛfa a mmara taa akyi

spans.text: Obiara wɔ banbɔde yi kyɛfa a mmara taa akyi.

folded.id: wɔ ho|kwan|sɛ ɔno nko ara pɛ ahonyade anaasɛ ɔne afoforò pɛ bi
folded.subject: wɔ ho
folded.object: sɛ ɔno nko ara pɛ ahonyade anaasɛ ɔne afoforò pɛ bi

spans.text: Obiara wɔ ho kwan sɛ ɔno nko ara pɛ ahonyade anaasɛ ɔne afoforò pɛ bi.

folded.id: wɔ ho|kwan|sɛ wogye no tom sɛ onipa
folded.subject: wɔ ho
folded.object: sɛ wogye no tom sɛ onipa

spans.text: Mmara mu no, onipa biara wɔ ho kwan sɛ wogye no tom sɛ onipa.

folded.id: wɔ mpaemuka|yi|mu no a nnipa animhwɛ anaa nyiyim nni mu
folded.subject: wɔ Mpaemuka
folded.object: mu no a nnipa animhwɛ anaa nyiyim nni mu

spans.text: Ɛsɛ sɛ obiara nya kyɛfa ne ahofadi ahorow a wɔaka ho asɛm wɔ Mpaemuka yi mu no a nnipa animhwɛ anaa nyiyim nni mu, te sɛ ebia abusua a ofi mu, ahosu, sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbea anaa ɔbarima, sɛ ɔka kasa bi anaa ɔwɔ kuw bi mu, sɛ ɔwɔ ahode, sɛ wɔwoo no ɔkwan bi so no mfa ho koraa.

folded.id: wɔde fekuwbɔ|mu|akyigyina ka ho
folded.subject: wɔde fekuwbɔ
folded.object: akyigyina ka ho

spans.text: Sɛ ehia nso a, ɛsɛ wɔde fekuwbɔ mu akyigyina ka ho.

folded.id: wɔn asɔre|mu|nhyehyɛe nsiw wɔn mu ni kwan a
folded.subject: wɔn asɔre
folded.object: nhyehyɛe nsiw wɔn mu ni kwan a

spans.text: Sɛ mmarima anaa mmea bi du wɔn mpanyin afe so, na wɔn abusua, wɔn man anaa wɔn asɔre mu nhyehyɛe nsiw wɔn mu ni kwan a, ɛnde wɔwɔ kyɛfa anaa hokwan sɛ wɔware kyekye abusua.
